provider: Earth & Space Research / NOAA PIFSC ERDDAP mirror
layer_interpretation: Satellite-derived near-surface product with nominal 15 m coordinate; not a direct 15 m instrument section or depth-resolved velocity.
time_convention: 72 nominal five-day 2013 archive samples, with four six-day gaps, January 1 through December 26. One year, not climatology or adequate evidence for annual extrema.

sections.source_scope: Offshore Portugal flow; Martins et al. (2002) statistical box constrains peak search only, not boundaries. Exclude coastal poleward flow and upstream/equatorial circulation.
Southern subtropical-gyre eastward component at 30 W; surface section is separate from the existing intermediate-depth float route. SAC/ACC and branch correspondence require independent review.
Eastern South Pacific surface component near the source STF region; source front crossing is not assumed velocity axis. Split-band/branch correspondence unresolved.

South Indian Ocean Current naming context at 80 E near 40 S, east of the Agulhas Return naming transition and west of the 90 E split. Near-surface peaks cannot inherit historical upper-1000 m transport identity; ACC, north subtropical front and eddy attribution remain unresolved.

Eastward Subarctic/Aleutian flow convention in Favorite (1967), Figure 27, investigated at 160 W. OSW chooses a 46-51 N peak-search window around the regional schematic reach, not observed current edges. Surface peaks may be eddies or North Pacific exchange; no cold-water property gate or historical upper-1000 m identity transfer. Westward Alaskan Stream and Bering-side North Slope Current remain separate.
